channel.title: NorthEast News
channel.description: Clear, fast reporting for New Hampshire and New England.

item.title: New Hampshire fire departments honor fallen Raymond firefighter
item.description: More than a dozen departments joined a dignified transfer for Eric Phillips, who died after a medical emergency while responding to a call.

item.title: Dover to dedicate permanent 9/11 memorial on 25th anniversary
item.description: The city plans an 11 a.m. remembrance ceremony Friday in the Cocheco Mill Courtyard, where its new memorial will be dedicated.

item.title: Bicyclist seriously injured in Medway collision
item.description: A car-and-bicycle crash Tuesday night sent one person to the hospital and temporarily closed part of Milford Street near Clark Street.

item.title: Judge allows asset attachments in Trooper Trainor family lawsuit
item.description: The ruling permits plaintiffs to attach a restaurant owner’s home and liquor license while a $20 million civil case moves into discovery.

item.title: Brown launches $37 million alliance for aging research
item.description: Brown University and Brown University Health will link laboratory work with clinical trials through a new Starr Foundation-backed partnership.

item.title: Spotted lanternfly spread puts Rhode Island vineyards on watch
item.description: The invasive insect is established in all five counties, prompting vineyards and state researchers to expand monitoring of vines and nearby host trees.

item.title: Iran attacks U.S. base in Jordan and ships near Hormuz
item.description: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard launched missiles toward a U.S. base and said it struck 10 ships after American forces destroyed five Iranian tankers.

item.title: Search underway for eight missing near Anak Krakatau
item.description: A speedboat carrying five photojournalists, two crew members and a guide lost contact while traveling to report on the Indonesian volcano.

item.title: OpenAI and Samsung deepen work on next-generation chips
item.description: OpenAI says the companies are advancing joint semiconductor work and expanding enterprise AI cooperation in South Korea.

item.title: Apple set for first major product event under new CEO
item.description: The September 9 showcase is expected to introduce new iPhones and could offer the first public look at Apple’s next hardware strategy.

item.title: Google plans Wed, 09 Sep 2026 07:41:00 GMT 5 billion AI infrastructure investment in Finland
item.description: Alphabet’s Google says it will spend at least €13 billion over two years on data centers, power grids and supporting clean-energy projects.

item.title: Amazon enters sterling bond market for first time
item.description: The company began marketing four pound-denominated maturities as large technology firms diversify funding for heavy AI investment.

item.title: Hawksmoor opens third U.S. restaurant in Boston’s Fort Point
item.description: The London-born steakhouse has opened on Necco Street with a Boston-specific menu alongside its signature dry-aged steaks.

item.title: Boston week ahead spans metal, salsa and carnival
item.description: Iron Maiden, a Roxbury jazz trio, a free salsa block party and Cambridge Carnival anchor a busy post-Labor Day calendar.

item.title: Wolfeboro selectmen reject demolition of Libby Museum
item.description: The board voted to keep the historic natural-history museum standing and begin work toward new stewardship after strong public support for preservation.

item.title: White Mountains forecasters expect later, longer foliage season
item.description: Healthy canopies and improved moisture conditions could support bright color from late September into mid-October, depending on elevation and weather.

item.title: Three Lindsay Clancy jurors describe deadlock after mistrial
item.description: The jury foreperson and two other panelists told NBC10 Boston that one holdout prevented agreement in the closely watched murder case.

item.title: Four injured in Framingham Route 9 rear-end crash
item.description: One person was flown to Boston Medical Center and three others went to MetroWest Medical Center after the Sunday-night collision.

item.title: Providence woman charged after Pawtucket hit-and-run
item.description: Police say a stolen vehicle struck a 48-year-old man riding an electric unicycle, leaving him with life-threatening injuries.

item.title: Riders press to keep RIPTA hub at Kennedy Plaza
item.description: A Providence coalition organized a rally opposing proposals to move the downtown bus terminal near the Amtrak station.

item.title: IAEA reports new North Korea uranium-enrichment facility
item.description: The nuclear watchdog says a two-story building at Yongbyon could hold up to 28 centrifuge cascades as infrastructure expands at multiple sites.

item.title: Ukraine contracts for about 1,000 Patriot missiles
item.description: Kyiv’s defense chief says most deliveries will take years and is asking allies to release interceptors from existing stocks sooner.

item.title: DeepSeek taps CITIC Securities for Shanghai IPO preparations
item.description: Sources say the Chinese AI startup has selected the brokerage for work ahead of a possible STAR Market listing, though final terms remain undecided.

item.title: GalaxEye wins U.S. patent for combined radar-optical satellite imaging
item.description: The Indian space startup says its technology synchronizes two sensor types to capture more consistent Earth-observation data through darkness and clouds.

item.title: Stronger yen puts carry trade under renewed pressure
item.description: Expectations for Bank of Japan tightening are narrowing the advantage of borrowing cheaply in yen to buy higher-yielding assets.

item.title: Singapore Airlines seeks stronger terms before new Air India funding
item.description: Sources say the 25.1% shareholder wants greater governance influence and loss-reduction commitments before providing more capital.

item.title: Rhode Island launches NFL-themed Powerball Xs & Os game
item.description: The $5 game asks players to select eight team logos, with weekly drawings beginning September 13 and a rolling jackpot starting at Wed, 09 Sep 2026 06:41:00 GMT million.

item.title: Ossipee nursing-home program helps 93-year-old return to lake
item.description: Mountain View Community arranged adaptive equipment so resident Ruth Beckwith could swim at Wentworth State Park with her family.

item.title: Stefany Shaheen wins narrow Democratic primary in New Hampshire’s 1st District
item.description: The former Portsmouth city councilor prevailed over Maura Sullivan and will face Republican Anthony DiLorenzo for the open U.S. House seat.

item.title: Nearly 300 New Hampshire residents may lose Medicaid October 1
item.description: State health officials identified 296 people whose full coverage may end when federal eligibility rules narrow for some noncitizens.

item.title: New Bedford motorcyclist dies after Walnut Street crash
item.description: Police say 21-year-old Anthony Navarro Rodriguez died after a Friday night collision with a sedan; the investigation remains open.

item.title: Motorcycle-SUV crash seriously injures two in Lakeville
item.description: A Yamaha motorcycle and Honda CR-V collided on Route 18 Monday evening, sending both drivers to Morton Hospital.

item.title: Two men charged in separate Twin River casino cheque thefts
item.description: Rhode Island State Police say unrelated incidents involved gaming cheques picked up from casino tables or floors; both cases are allegations.

item.title: Smoke alarms help Cranston family escape early-morning fire
item.description: Fire officials believe flames began outside a Brayton Avenue home before spreading inside; everyone escaped without injury.

item.title: Russian drones hit Ukraine-Moldova border crossing
item.description: Ukraine’s border service reported deaths, injuries and fires after an overnight strike, while Kyiv also faced attacks without reported casualties.

item.title: U.S. expands Iran aviation sanctions in new Treasury action
item.description: The Treasury Department designated dozens of airlines and related entities while suspending authorizations for some Iranian aviation activity.

item.title: Adyen plans further India expansion as local business grows
item.description: The Dutch payments company has increased its India workforce tenfold since 2023 and is adapting its platform to local payment rules.

item.title: Activist investor seeks Samsung shareholder registers in S-1 campaign
item.description: Flashlight Capital Partners wants records from five Samsung affiliates that together own 20.6% of the security-services company.

item.title: NSE India IPO likely to target 1,700 to 1,785 rupees a share
item.description: The expected range could value the exchange at about $46.4 billion at the top end ahead of a planned September listing.

item.title: Japan manufacturer sentiment reaches nearly five-year high
item.description: A Reuters survey showed electronics demand lifting factory confidence, while services sentiment also edged higher.

item.title: Astronaut Butch Wilmore brings space stories to Warwick schools
item.description: The retired NASA astronaut and Navy captain visited Winman Middle School and Scott Elementary after completing 464 days in space.

item.title: Campanella’s in Cranston plans September 16 reopening
item.description: The longtime restaurant is preparing to welcome customers back after the Campanella family purchased it from a court-appointed receiver.

item.title: New Hampshire selects nine locations for post-election audit
item.description: Ballot-counting devices from nine towns and city wards will be checked publicly at the State Archives, with a report due Friday.

item.title: Chesterfield police chief becomes town’s only active officer
item.description: A run of resignations has left Chief Lance Rouse as the only department employee legally able to respond, forcing the town to weigh temporary service changes.

item.title: Massachusetts mails voter guide covering nine ballot questions
item.description: The state’s “Red Book” is headed to every household ahead of a general-election ballot containing a record-tying nine referendums.

item.title: Driver held on $250,000 bail in fatal Framingham hit-and-run case
item.description: Prosecutors say a 44-year-old Framingham man struck and killed pedestrian Philip Bligh on Sunday night, left the scene and later returned.

item.title: Johnston school-bus contractor acknowledges scheduling error
item.description: Zum told the School Committee that its planning omitted 15 minutes for elementary-school loading as families pressed for fixes to late arrivals and long rides.

item.title: Battery pack blamed for North Smithfield trash-truck fire
item.description: Firefighters used a thermal camera to locate a lithium-ion battery after a Waste Management driver dumped the smoking load away from homes.

item.title: UK airports work through backlog after air-traffic system failure
item.description: NATS said a flight-data processing fault was resolved, but cancellations and delays continued across major British airports as airlines repositioned aircraft and crews.

item.title: NTSB data indicates Miami cargo crew considered aborting landing
item.description: Investigators say throttle and brake movements suggest the pilots briefly tried a go-around after touchdown before the Boeing 767 overran the runway.

item.title: Australia proposes right to opt out of algorithmic feeds
item.description: Draft legislation would require social platforms to give users 16 and older a lasting choice between recommended content and posts from accounts they follow.

item.title: Huawei racketeering trial begins with jury selection in New York
item.description: Federal prosecutors accuse the telecommunications company of a long-running scheme involving trade secrets, fraud and sanctions violations; Huawei denies the allegations.

item.title: Oil approaches $100 as Asian markets open mixed
item.description: Brent reached its highest level since late June in early Wednesday trading while regional stock indexes split between gains and losses.

item.title: Coforge shares fall after chairman resigns over board-review concerns
item.description: The Indian IT-services company dropped more than 7 percent after Om Prakash Bhatt left following concerns identified in an internal audit.

item.title: Logan Airport’s two 9/11 flags maintain a quiet memorial
item.description: For 25 years, American flags near the gates used by Flights 11 and 175 have honored the passengers and crews who departed Boston on September 11, 2001.

item.title: Boston-born 9to5 movement’s labor legacy returns to focus
item.description: A campaign organized by women office workers in the early 1970s pushed for fair pay and an end to workplace harassment, later inspiring a film and Dolly Parton anthem.

item.title: Shaheen and Sullivan locked in close New Hampshire 1st District primary
item.description: The Democratic contest for the open U.S. House seat remained uncalled late Tuesday, with two percentage points separating the candidates in an Associated Press tally.

item.title: Concord panel advances $22.4 million Memorial Field plan
item.description: A joint city-school committee backed a two-phase renovation proposal, sending the project toward public hearings and votes by local governing bodies.

item.title: Nine charged in alleged Massachusetts benefit-fraud scheme
item.description: Federal prosecutors say stolen identities were used to obtain nearly $1 million through SNAP, MassHealth and Social Security programs.

item.title: Angels end Red Sox five-game winning streak with 6-1 win
item.description: Reid Detmers threw six scoreless innings and Zach Neto had four hits as Boston’s offense was held to four hits.

item.title: Apple Cinemas plans multimillion-dollar Providence Place overhaul
item.description: The theater operator says upgraded auditoriums, immersive screens and entertainment attractions are planned for the mall complex.

item.title: Two face charges after Cranston traffic-stop drug seizure
item.description: Police say a vehicle search produced about 30 grams of suspected methamphetamine, prescription pills and drug paraphernalia.

item.title: Iran says it captured U.S. underwater drone near Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The Pentagon confirmed a Dive-LD vehicle malfunctioned during a survey mission but said it carried no classified or sensitive equipment.

item.title: Relative says four family members found dead after Bahamas plane disappeared
item.description: Relatives located the victims after launching a search for the small plane, which lost contact while flying toward Miami.

item.title: Cognition AI raises $2 billion at $48 billion valuation
item.description: The autonomous coding-agent company says its run-rate revenue has climbed to nearly $900 million since a May financing.

item.title: Google redesigns European search results to comply with DMA
item.description: The company is giving comparison services more prominence after an EU fine, while removing some real-time details from result carousels.

item.title: Adani Airports to raise about $1 billion from investor group
item.description: The airport operator will issue new shares representing up to 5.54% to investors including Temasek, BlackRock, Premji Invest and Alpha Wave.

item.title: LIV Golf files for Chapter 11 with more than $500 million in debt
item.description: The league is seeking a court-supervised restructuring in New Jersey after Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund ended financial support.

item.title: East Providence grower cultivates hundreds of pawpaw trees
item.description: Joe Barros has spent 15 years building a backyard collection of North America’s largest native fruit and inviting neighbors to try it.

item.title: Aaron Judge returns to Yankees lineup after 84-game absence
item.description: The New York captain started in right field Tuesday after recovering from a stress fracture in his right first rib.

item.title: New Hampshire primary voters describe distrust and ambivalence
item.description: Interviews at polling places found many Granite Staters voting from civic duty or concern about specific issues rather than enthusiasm for candidates.

item.title: Mount Washington tribute will shine twin beams for four nights
item.description: The Honor Summit remembrance begins Wednesday, with organizers shortening nightly hours after consulting wildlife specialists.

item.title: Chicopee electric dirt-bike rider faces charges after crash
item.description: Police say the unregistered and uninsured bike had no headlight or taillight when it collided with a vehicle near an I-391 offramp.

item.title: Police say Jeep fled Chicopee stop before striking Agawam ambulance
item.description: A new police account links the weekend Springfield crash to an earlier traffic stop; two paramedics suffered minor injuries.

item.title: Peach Cobbler Factory opens first New England shop in Providence
item.description: The Southern-dessert chain has opened near Federal Hill with cobblers, banana pudding, cinnamon rolls and late-night weekend hours.

item.title: Route 146 wrong-way crash suspect arraigned on DUI charges
item.description: Kevin Migna was released on personal recognizance and ordered not to drive after an August crash that injured one person.

item.title: Iran launches missiles toward U.S. targets in Jordan after tanker strikes
item.description: Jordan said it intercepted most of 18 ballistic missiles as the latest U.S.-Iran exchange raised fears of a wider regional conflict.

item.title: Hurricane Lowell knocks out power across Kauai and damages coast
item.description: Nearly all of the island utility’s members lost electricity as destructive winds, heavy rain and large waves battered western Hawaii.

item.title: OpenAI expands AI tools into chip design and specialized industries
item.description: The company says its models helped move an internal chip project to tape-out in nine months as it pursues enterprise work beyond general chat.

item.title: FCC proposes opening more spectrum for space-based broadband
item.description: The agency plans a September 30 vote on changes covering the 12 GHz and 42 GHz bands, satellite links and ultra-wideband devices.

item.title: Holtec Nuclear seeks up to $10.2 billion valuation in U.S. IPO
item.description: The New Jersey company plans to offer 50 million shares as investor interest grows around nuclear power and data-center electricity demand.

item.title: EverBank and WaFd agree to $3.9 billion reverse merger
item.description: The all-stock transaction would create a bank with about $75 billion in assets and give EverBank’s investors a majority stake.

item.title: Patriots rule out TreVeyon Henderson for season opener in Seattle
item.description: The running back will miss Wednesday’s Super Bowl rematch because of an ankle injury, increasing the expected workload for Rhamondre Stevenson.

item.title: Plymouth volunteers help 94-year-old return to White Horse Beach
item.description: Community members helped Alison Blomgren reach the sand after her daughter asked for assistance fulfilling a birthday wish.

item.title: Anthony DiLorenzo wins GOP primary for open New Hampshire House seat
item.description: The Trump-backed businessman advances in the race to replace Rep. Chris Pappas in the 1st Congressional District.

item.title: Goodlander and Williams win New Hampshire 2nd District primaries
item.description: The incumbent Democrat and Republican challenger will meet again after facing each other in the district’s 2024 general election.

item.title: Taunton crash snaps utility pole and damages new food truck
item.description: Witnesses helped the driver after a car hit a pole and the week-old Hetty’s Sweets Bakery and Savory Foods truck on Route 138.

item.title: Swansea property dispute puts local Toys for Tots drive in doubt
item.description: The Bristol and North Plymouth counties coordinator says an access agreement could pull the charity into a dispute over a baseball complex.

item.title: Hasbro targets January for Boston headquarters as Pawtucket exit nears
item.description: One year after announcing the relocation, the company says its Seaport headquarters is expected to open in January while employee moves may begin sooner.

item.title: Johnston parents rally as school-bus delays and long rides continue
item.description: Families say communication and routing problems persist weeks after the district began working with a new transportation provider.

item.title: Worker injured in Burrillville construction-site roof collapse
item.description: Town officials are investigating after roof framing collapsed near Douglas Pike and Ironmine Road Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: Five killed in Miami cargo-jet crash were in ground-crew van
item.description: Investigators say the victims were inside a plane-cleaning vehicle when a Boeing 767 ran off the runway at Miami International Airport.

item.title: Logan Airport deploys ‘Amelia’ AI holograms at nine locations
item.description: The multilingual digital assistant is designed to help travelers navigate terminals and find hundreds of Boston destinations, including after staffed hours.

item.title: ASML plans larger masks for High-NA tools and data-center chips
item.description: The chip-equipment maker says an industry consortium could adapt its most advanced lithography systems for today’s largest AI processors.

item.title: Tamarack and Headwater agree to $7.25 billion oil merger
item.description: The all-stock transaction would create the largest publicly traded producer focused on Alberta’s Clearwater Formation.

item.title: Verizon signs multibillion-dollar fiber deal with Corning
item.description: Corning will supply more than 80 million miles of high-density optical fiber from 2027 through 2032 for broadband and AI infrastructure.

item.title: Bruins sign Fraser Minten to seven-year, $50.4 million extension
item.description: The 22-year-old center is under contract through 2033-34 after producing 35 points in his first full season with Boston.

item.title: Boston fashion designer and philanthropist Yolanda Celucci dies at 91
item.description: A prominent figure in the region’s fashion community, Celucci also helped raise millions of dollars for charity through the Waltham Lions Club.

item.title: Chris Pappas wins New Hampshire Democratic Senate primary
item.description: The three-term congressman advances to a nationally watched general-election contest for the seat being vacated by retiring Sen. Jeanne Shaheen.

item.title: John E. Sununu wins New Hampshire Republican Senate primary
item.description: The former senator defeated Scott Brown and will face Democrat Chris Pappas for New Hampshire’s open U.S. Senate seat.

item.title: Springfield schools stay closed as severe cyberattack response continues
item.description: The district will remain shut Wednesday as officials work without access to student health, transportation and food-service systems.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy’s lawyer asks Trump for pardon after mistrial
item.description: The request faces a basic jurisdictional obstacle: presidential pardon power covers federal offenses, while the Massachusetts case was brought under state law.

item.title: Rhode Island primary sets record for early in-person voting
item.description: More than 37,000 voters cast ballots before Election Day, more than doubling the state’s previous primary-year benchmark.

item.title: Juvenile charged with murder in Providence killing of Joseph Ramos
item.description: Police say a 17-year-old was arraigned in Family Court Tuesday after an investigation into the May shooting death of the 20-year-old.

item.title: Ayotte and Warmington win New Hampshire governor primaries
item.description: The incumbent Republican governor and former Democratic Executive Councilor advance to the November general election.

item.title: U.S. says it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers after warship attacks
item.description: Central Command said the strikes answered two attempted ballistic-missile attacks on a U.S. warship over two days.

item.title: U.S. accuses six Chinese AI firms of malicious model copying
item.description: Officials say companies including DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Alibaba used American model outputs at scale to accelerate their own systems.

item.title: Meta launches Muse AI agent with email, payment and app access
item.description: The new assistant can work across connected services in the background, putting privacy and security controls at the center of its rollout.

item.title: GE Aerospace to buy castings supplier CPP for $11.75 billion
item.description: The planned acquisition would bring a critical engine-parts supplier in-house as manufacturers work through persistent production bottlenecks.

item.title: Chime agrees to buy Stride Bank for $590 million
item.description: The fintech company is seeking a national bank charter and more control over the infrastructure behind its accounts and lending expansion.

item.title: ‘Man in the Red Bandana’ Welles Crowther awarded Medal of Freedom
item.description: The Boston College graduate and volunteer firefighter was honored posthumously for helping people escape the World Trade Center on Sept. 11.

item.title: First ‘Remain’ trailer brings Rhode Island-shot thriller into view
item.description: M. Night Shyamalan’s supernatural romance, filmed around the Ocean State, pairs Jake Gyllenhaal and Phoebe Dynevor ahead of a February release.

item.title: Manchester woman charged after crash seriously injures 1-year-old
item.description: Police say a two-vehicle crash in Manchester sent a child to Boston Children’s Hospital and led to aggravated OUI and child-endangerment charges.

item.title: Canada’s new tariffs put New Hampshire trade links in focus
item.description: Ottawa imposed tariffs on about $20 billion in U.S. goods Tuesday, adding fresh uncertainty for a New Hampshire economy tied to its northern neighbor.

item.title: 46,000 Boston students return as schools start new year
item.description: Boston Public Schools welcomed students Tuesday as the district began a new year with a fully district-run elementary school and a renewed focus on bus reliability.

item.title: Massachusetts’ new heat-resilience role puts extreme heat on state agenda
item.description: The state is among the first to build a dedicated government response around a hazard that often causes serious health risks without obvious property damage.

item.title: Providence mayoral primary turns on rent control and housing growth
item.description: Mayor Brett Smiley and state Rep. David Morales are offering competing answers to the city’s affordability crisis ahead of Wednesday’s Democratic primary.

item.title: Rhode Island primary tests more than the governor’s race
item.description: Wednesday’s contest includes federal, state and local nominations, with Providence’s mayoral race and a large unaffiliated electorate adding to the stakes.

item.title: Everett City Hall closes after cybersecurity incident
item.description: The city said its internal network and technology systems were affected Tuesday, while police, fire, schools, libraries and online payments continued operating.

item.title: Car fire stalls afternoon traffic on I-95 in Foxborough
item.description: A large vehicle fire temporarily closed two southbound lanes near Exit 18 Tuesday afternoon while officials worked at the scene.

item.title: Massachusetts offers record package to keep Insulet
item.description: State officials are offering $40 million in incentives as the Acton medical-device company weighs its future footprint in the Commonwealth.

item.title: New Massachusetts data-center rules require local support and clean energy
item.description: Gov. Maura Healey’s executive order ties state permits for new facilities to community agreements, energy protections and environmental review.

item.title: Oil hits six-week high after attacks on Saudi energy sites
item.description: Brent crude and U.S. oil rose after attacks on Saudi facilities intensified supply concerns and added to inflation pressure for investors.

item.title: HSBC raises S&P 500 year-end target to 8,100
item.description: The bank cited stronger corporate earnings and AI-infrastructure investment while warning that inflation, rates and geopolitics could still unsettle markets.

item.title: Topsfield Fair warns vendors about scam emails
item.description: Fair organizers say vendors should be cautious about messages that appear to come from the event and request sensitive information or payments.

item.title: Stanley Cup coming to Stoughton High School Thursday
item.description: Carolina Hurricanes equipment manager Jorge Alves, a 1997 Stoughton graduate, will bring the championship trophy to his former school.

item.title: New Hampshire voters head to polls as open Senate seat reshapes 2026 races
item.description: Tuesday’s primary is the first major test of the campaigns competing to succeed retiring U.S. Sen. Jeanne Shaheen.

item.title: Boston Scientific says cyberattack could hit its 2026 outlook
item.description: The Marlborough-based medical-device maker said an August incident disrupted parts of its global operations.

item.title: Qualcomm and Amazon deepen AI-chip ties in multibillion-dollar agreement
item.description: The deal expands Amazon’s custom-chip push and gives Qualcomm another foothold in AI infrastructure.

item.title: New Hampshire businesses build community around alcohol-free drinks
item.description: Concord and Manchester businesses are adding nonalcoholic drinks and social spaces as more customers look for alternatives to traditional bars.

item.title: Concord farm meets high local demand for greens after lettuce recalls
item.description: A two-person farm says it has been selling out weekly as shoppers and restaurants put a premium on local lettuce and microgreens.

item.title: UMass Boston chancellor plans to step down in February
item.description: Marcelo Suárez-Orozco will leave the post after seven years, closing a tenure that included campus growth and a major capital overhaul.

item.title: Eastern Massachusetts seeks more Quabbin water as review begins
item.description: A request for up to 20 million additional gallons a day is prompting questions about which communities need the supply and what alternatives were considered.

item.title: Rhode Island governor primary rematch centers on bridge and trust
item.description: Incumbent Dan McKee and Helena Foulkes are facing each other again, with the Washington Bridge crisis and state leadership at the center of the contest.

item.title: What Rhode Island voters should know before Wednesday’s primary
item.description: The state’s Sept. 9 primary will release results through 39 local jurisdictions, with early and mail ballots mixed into the night’s reporting.

item.title: New Hampshire school-ID voting rule gets first test at UNH
item.description: A new identification rule was challenged in federal court but appeared to create few problems for Durham voters during Tuesday’s primary.

item.title: Springfield public schools close after cyber incident
item.description: All public schools and after-school activities were canceled Tuesday while officials investigated an incident affecting systems used for essential operations.

item.title: South Station’s high-tech fare gates hit a weather problem
item.description: Nearly half the commuter-rail gates were covered during a recent rainy morning, limiting ticket scanning at Boston’s busiest station.

item.title: Massachusetts data centers face local approval before state permits
item.description: Gov. Maura Healey’s new order requires community agreements and bars state-agency nondisclosure deals with proposed facilities.

item.title: Biotech shares slide after Novartis muscle-disease trial setback
item.description: Dyne, Sarepta and PepGen fell after a late-stage Novartis drug failed to show a statistically significant benefit in a muscle-disease trial.

item.title: Software stocks fall as investors weigh the next AI disruption
item.description: Salesforce, Intuit and ServiceNow were among the software names under pressure as investors turned to inflation data and the pace of AI adoption.

item.title: Patriots’ Christian Gonzalez agrees to record cornerback contract
item.description: The four-year, $135 million deal would make Gonzalez the highest-paid cornerback in NFL history, according to people who spoke with the AP.

item.title: Neighbors and firefighters rescue 17-year-old dog in Dorchester
item.description: Milly, who is blind and deaf, wandered from her fenced yard before a neighborhood search brought her safely home about four hours later.
